resources.string: Defer downloads until the device is on Wi-Fi or another unmetered network. Saves cellular data but pauses queued downloads when off Wi-Fi.
Confirm before starting video playback on a metered connection. Music and direct-play audio are unaffected.
Maximum resolution and bitrate, and the format used when converting. Saved to your account and applied on every device.
Clear your session on this device. The server URL is kept so you can sign in again with the same account.
Remove the server URL and all session state. Use when switching to a different OnScreen deployment.
You\'ll need to sign in again to continue using OnScreen on this device.
This removes the server URL and all session state. You\'ll start over from the server-URL prompt.
Add a code from an authenticator app to your password login.
Submit a listen when you finish a music track.
App version, build, and connected server.

Even out loudness between music tracks using their ReplayGain tags. Album keeps an album’s own dynamics and falls back to track gain for singles. Untagged files play unchanged, and the gain never pushes a track into clipping.
Added to every tagged track’s gain. A boost stops where the track would clip.

Auto picks 4K (HEVC, HDR) for devices it recognises, such as a Chromecast Ultra, Chromecast with Google TV or Google TV Streamer, and HD for the rest. Choose 4K if your TV plays 4K but casts in HD. If a 4K cast fails, it is retried in HD.
The language of OnScreen\'s menus and buttons. Saved to your account, so your other devices use it too.
Couldn\'t save the language to your account. It\'s still used on this device.
